archive: git clone https://github.com/fluffos/nt7 (王者归来, "泥潭7" — already a UTF-8/FluffOS-v2019-adapted community fork, not a raw legacy archive)
name: 王者归来
english_description: A member of the NT/nitan/Lonely engine family (see nitan170911, nitan6, hhsj, xfbhh, nt1, nt6) sourced from an already-git-hosted, community-maintained fork rather than a raw archive: the upstream repo had already been transcoded to UTF-8 and adapted for a modern FluffOS driver years before this pass. Core daemons (master.lpc, logind.lpc, securityd.lpc, chinesed.lpc) share the family's overall shape but have diverged substantially in content from every sibling checked (hundreds to thousands of differing lines even after whitespace normalization) -- a real independent branch, not a duplicate. New characters undergo the same Pangu creation-myth 'birth ceremony' as hhsj/nt6 (choose a personality, wash attributes in the Valley of Life, land in the Ancient Village), but nt7's own object-property-storage architecture (the family's classic set()/query() 'this_object() resolves to the wrong object inside a simul_efun' bug, AGENTS.md's own biggest historical bug class for this lineage) was already correctly implemented upstream using previous_object() -- confirmed NOT present here, unlike its unfixed state on nitan170911/nitan6/hhsj/xfbhh/nt6/nt6nitan6win/nt1 before this project's own fixes. Chinese-name detection likewise already uses a real Unicode \p{Han} regex rather than the family's classic GBK-byte-range hack.
